seo_title: Explore Scholarships Open to Non-US Citizens
seo_description: Discover 196 scholarships available for non-US citizens. Find funding opportunities tailored to international students today.
intro: Navigating funding opportunities as a non-US citizen can be challenging, but there are numerous scholarships available specifically for international students. With 196 scholarships currently open, you can find financial support tailored to your unique situation. From merit-based awards to need-based assistance, these scholarships can help you pursue your educational goals in the United States. This guide will help you explore various options and provide insights into the application process, eligibility criteria, and deadlines, ensuring you have the best chance of securing funding.
supporting: Eligibility for these scholarships varies widely, with some open to undergraduate and graduate students, while others may focus on specific fields of study or demographic groups. For instance, the Paul and Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans supports immigrants and children of immigrants pursuing graduate education. Deadlines also vary, so it’s essential to check each scholarship's specific requirements. When applying, ensure you have all necessary documents, such as transcripts, letters of recommendation, and personal statements, ready to submit. Tailoring your application to highlight your unique background and aspirations can significantly enhance your chances of receiving an award.
related_intro: In addition to scholarships, non-US citizens may also explore grants, fellowships, and assistantships that can provide financial support for their studies.
how_to_use: Browse the list of 196 scholarships available.
Check eligibility criteria for each scholarship.
Prepare required documents like transcripts and essays.
Follow up on your applications and seek additional funding if needed.
who_for: Non-US citizens pursuing undergraduate or graduate studies.
Students from diverse backgrounds looking for merit-based awards.

faq.question: Are these scholarships only for specific fields of study?
faq.answer: No, many scholarships are available across various fields, while some may focus on specific disciplines.

faq.question: Can I apply for multiple scholarships?
faq.answer: Yes, you can apply for multiple scholarships as long as you meet their individual eligibility requirements.

faq.question: What documents do I need to apply?
faq.answer: Typically, you will need transcripts, letters of recommendation, and personal statements, but requirements may vary by scholarship.
